ValidationRule.description: This is to control the Financial and Non-FInancial Compensation field based on Complaint Remedy selection
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT( ISNEW() ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( IDR_Complaint_Remedy__c , '1'), ISBLANK( IDR_Financial_Compensation__c ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL( IDR_Complaint_Remedy__c , '2'), ISPICKVAL( IDR_Non_Financial_Remedy__c, '')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please populate financial compensation or non-financial remedy based on your selection in complaint remedy
